resources.string: Drop onto the bubble, or share images, PDFs, text, or links from another app. Pocket copies them onto one shelf.

The Pocket bubble sits over other apps. Drop a file onto it when Android delivers the drop, or open Share and choose Pocket. Pocket copies the file, text, or link into its own shelf while the grant is still valid, so the original can go away.\n\nYou can also tap Add items and choose files, or add a note. Tap the bubble to open the shelf, share everything out, or hide it. Select several items to share or remove them together, or arrange the shelf.
